# GhostShell

> Two free, open-source desktop tools: one for Blu-ray and DVD discs you own,
> one for managing an Xbox 360 game library over FTP.

Site: https://ghostyshell.github.io/

## Projects

- Keepsake Atelier - https://ghostyshell.github.io/keepsake-atelier/ - rip, author,
  verify and burn discs with native tooling; AACS key recovery, BD-J menus,
  1:1 clones, MCP server. macOS, Linux, Windows.
- GODsend 360 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/GODSend-360/ - Xbox 360 game manager
  for Aurora: Minerva Archive and Internet Archive browsing, ISO to GOD conversion,
  DLC, title updates and save backups over FTP. Windows, macOS, Linux.

Both are MIT licensed, need no account, and have no subscription.
